own_solution.law: Snell's law n1 sin(theta1) = n2 sin(theta2)

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: T5C47 and T200C say 'a little' with no number, while their apparent counterparts TE499 and T2A20 state 11 degrees, so they do not state the same number and unit.
defect_reasons.other: T7C68 says the laser was tilted 11 degrees farther after the angle of incidence was set, which makes the incidence 51 degrees and sits awkwardly with the earlier present-tense 'is 40 degrees'.

notes: Base: sin r = sin40/1.5 = 0.64279/1.5 = 0.42853, r = 25.37 deg. With incidence 51 deg (T7C68, T0CA4): sin r = 0.77715/1.5 = 0.51810, r = 31.21 deg. The desk lamp sentences (TE499, T5C47) are about an object with no path to the ray: D. The earlier-experiment sentences (T2A20, T200C) are about a past configuration and do not affect the present ray: D. If T7C68 were read as describing the history before the stated 40 deg, it would be D; I read 'after the angle of incidence was set' as changing the current incidence to 51 deg.
